name: Facebook
refreshNote: Use the Sharing Debugger ('Scrape Again') or a Graph API POST with scrape=true. Otherwise Meta refreshes link metadata automatically about every 30 days. To change an image, use a new image URL so the cached image is not reused.
notes: Official (Sharing for Webmasters / Images): minimum 200x200; use at least 1200x630 for high-resolution displays; at least 600x315 for the large link-preview layout - smaller images still display but much smaller; aspect ratio ~1.91:1; max 8MB.
Images are cached asynchronously, so the image may not render the first time a URL is shared; specify og:image:width/height to allow immediate rendering.

Displayed: image, domain (uppercase), title, and often one line of description. Description is frequently hidden or cut in the mobile feed; og:site_name is read but the card shows the domain. Truncation is line-based and undocumented (null).

Fallbacks to <title>/meta description are inferred (Sharing Debugger reports 'inferred property' warnings when og: tags are missing); Meta may also infer an image from page content, which the token list cannot represent.
webp listed by secondary sources as supported, but some users report Sharing Debugger failures with webp - JPEG/PNG are the safe choice. SVG not supported.
og:image:alt is used for screen readers, not displayed visually.
Crawler must get OG tags within the first 1MB of the page; the same crawler (facebookexternalhit) serves Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and Threads link previews.

Verification method: official doc pages were located via web search (search-engine extracts of the official URLs listed in source); direct page fetches of the official domain were blocked from the research environment, so wording could not be re-read in full.
